measure.baggy_hip: Measure across the widest point, about 16 cm / 6.3 in below the waistband.
measure.baggy_waist: Measure straight across the top waistband, from edge to edge.
measure.jeans_hip: Measure across the widest point, about 16 cm / 6.3 in below the waistband, then double it.
measure.jeans_inseam: Measure from the crotch seam all the way down the inner leg to the hem.
measure.jeans_waist: Measure straight across the top waistband from edge to edge, then double it.
measure.shorts_inseam: Measure from the crotch seam down the inner leg to the hem.
measure.swim_hip: Lay the swim shorts flat. Measure straight across the widest part of the shorts. Do not double the measurement.
measure.swim_inseam: Measure from the crotch seam straight down the inner leg to the hem.
measure.swim_waist: Lay the swim shorts flat. Measure straight across the top of the waistband from edge to edge. Do not double the measurement.
measure.tshirt_body_length: Measure from the high point of shoulder (HPS) straight down to the bottom hem.
measure.tshirt_chest: Lay the T-shirt flat. Measure straight across from armpit to armpit just below the armholes. Do not double the measurement.
measure.tshirt_shoulder: Measure straight across from one shoulder seam to the other shoulder seam.
measure.tshirt_sleeve: Measure from the shoulder seam to the end of the sleeve.

notes.graded_reference_html: Size 33 was measured directly from the garment. Other sizes are graded from this reference and may be refined as additional production measurements are verified.
